conditions.name: Refractive-error pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Vision pattern consistent with a possible refractive error
conditions.summary: Blur mainly at distance or near can be associated with a focusing error that an eye examination can measure.
conditions.limitations: Other eye problems can also cause blur, so this pattern cannot identify the cause by itself.

conditions.name: Presbyopia pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Near-vision pattern consistent with possible presbyopia
conditions.summary: Gradually increasing difficulty with near tasks in adulthood can be associated with age-related focusing changes.
conditions.limitations: Sudden or painful vision change does not fit a routine near-vision pathway and needs faster assessment.

conditions.name: Dry-eye pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Symptoms consistent with a possible dry-eye pattern
conditions.summary: Grittiness, burning, intermittent blur, or watering can occur when the tear film does not adequately protect the eye surface.
conditions.limitations: Similar symptoms occur in infection, allergy, injury, and other eye-surface problems.

conditions.name: Blepharitis pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Eyelid symptoms consistent with possible blepharitis
conditions.summary: Crusting around eyelashes with irritated or itchy eyelid margins can occur with eyelid inflammation.
conditions.limitations: A painful lump, spreading swelling, vision change, or severe pain needs a different assessment pathway.

conditions.name: Stye or chalazion pattern
conditions.summary: A localized eyelid lump may be painful or painless and can arise from an eyelid gland.
conditions.limitations: The system cannot distinguish eyelid lump causes or examine for complications.

conditions.name: Allergic conjunctivitis pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Itchy, watery-eye pattern consistent with possible allergy
conditions.summary: Prominent itching and watering in both eyes can occur with allergic conjunctival irritation.
conditions.limitations: Discharge, pain, light sensitivity, contact-lens use, or vision change may require a different pathway.

conditions.name: Infectious conjunctivitis pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Red-eye and discharge pattern consistent with possible infectious conjunctivitis
conditions.summary: Redness and discharge, sometimes around a respiratory illness, can occur with viral or bacterial conjunctivitis.
conditions.limitations: Appearance alone cannot establish the cause; severe pain or vision change requires urgent assessment.

conditions.name: Cataract pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Gradual cloudy-vision pattern consistent with possible cataract
conditions.summary: Gradual cloudy or hazy vision and glare can occur when the natural lens of the eye becomes cloudy.
conditions.limitations: Only an eye examination can assess the lens and exclude other causes of gradual visual decline.

conditions.name: Chronic glaucoma risk pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Factors associated with possible glaucoma risk
conditions.summary: Age, family history, or gradual peripheral-vision concern can indicate a need for a comprehensive glaucoma assessment.
conditions.limitations: Glaucoma may have no early symptoms and cannot be screened out by this questionnaire.

conditions.name: Diabetic retinopathy risk
conditions.possible_indication_label: Diabetes-related retinal risk requiring eye review
conditions.summary: People with diabetes need regular dilated eye examinations because retinal changes can develop before noticeable symptoms.
conditions.limitations: The questionnaire cannot examine the retina or determine whether retinal changes are present.

conditions.name: Age-related macular degeneration pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Central-vision distortion pattern requiring prompt assessment
conditions.summary: Distorted straight lines or a new central blur in an older adult can be associated with a macular problem.
conditions.limitations: This pattern has several possible causes and needs a professional retinal examination.

conditions.name: Retinal detachment warning pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Retinal warning signs requiring emergency assessment
conditions.summary: A sudden shower of floaters, flashes, or a curtain-like shadow can accompany a retinal tear or detachment.
conditions.limitations: The retina cannot be evaluated through a questionnaire; delaying assessment can threaten sight.

conditions.name: Contact-lens infection warning pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Contact-lens red-eye warning signs requiring urgent assessment
conditions.summary: Pain, redness, light sensitivity, discharge, or vision change during contact-lens use can accompany a serious corneal infection.
conditions.limitations: A corneal examination is required and the system cannot determine infection type or severity.

conditions.name: Acute angle-closure warning pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Severe painful red-eye pattern requiring emergency assessment
conditions.summary: Sudden severe eye pain with redness, blurred vision or halos, headache, nausea, or vomiting can occur in acute angle closure.
conditions.limitations: This emergency pattern cannot confirm a cause; immediate examination and eye-pressure measurement are required.

conditions.name: Eye injury or chemical-exposure pattern
conditions.possible_indication_label: Eye injury warning signs requiring emergency assessment
conditions.summary: Chemical exposure, high-speed impact, an embedded object, or vision change after injury can seriously damage the eye.
conditions.limitations: Injury severity cannot be evaluated remotely and first aid must not delay emergency care.
